dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Your sync flows, their last run and their next run will appear here.
dashboard.emptyBody: A flow copies pages from one Master wiki to one or more Mirror wikis. Start by adding a connection to each wiki.

connections.title: Connections
connections.intro: A connection tells Tolarix how to reach one wiki: Azure DevOps, Confluence or an Obsidian vault.

flows.title: Flows
flows.intro: A flow mirrors a Master wiki, or part of it, into one or more Mirror wikis on a schedule or when you run it.
